correctness.rationale: For 0<alpha<=1, equal strengths and times tau0 r^{±1/2}, the exact loss reduces to sin(theta)(d cosh s+c)/(cosh²s+2cd cosh s+c²+d²-1). Independently symbolically differentiated the reduced rational function, recovering P(y)=d(d²-1-c²)-2cy-dy². P is strictly decreasing on y>=1, so its endpoint sign gives exactly one central peak, quartic flat equality, or two outer peaks; the root and monotonic threshold follow. Independent direct-loss evaluations for alpha=.25,.5,.75,1 corroborate the threshold and outer bifurcation. No finite sampling substitutes for the global derivative sign argument.
